scripts.package:build: npm run build:tooling && npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix packages/cloudflare run build && npm --prefix packages/node run build
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run package:build && npm test && npm run test:packages
scripts.smoke: npm run package:build && npm run test:packages
scripts.docs:preview:cloudflare: npm run docs:build && wrangler dev --config docs/wrangler.jsonc --port 4174
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && wrangler deploy --config docs/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs dev
scripts.compile: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs compile
scripts.build: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs && npm run test:release
scripts.deploy: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs deploy
scripts.cf-typegen: npm run build:tooling && node test/run.mjs cf-typegen
